blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—La Salle dominated University of Santo Tomas in the fourth quarter to win, 92-80, in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Sunday night at Ateneo Blue Eagle Gym. The Green Archers avenged their first-round loss to the Growling Tigers and notched their second straight win despite missing star guard Jacob Cortez, who sustained a knee injury in their overtime win over University of the East on Wednesday. La Salle trailed 67-73 with 8:42 left before going on a 25-7 surge capped by four straight points by Joaquin Tovera to put away UST, 92-80, with only 1:02 remaining. The […]...
